cards.bg-map: Flat 2D naturalist field-guide illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, clean shapes, gentle cel shading, warm parchment cream, moss green, ochre and slate-blue palette, thin warm-brown outlines, no 3D, no photo realism, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. An old hand-drawn naturalist's map of three regions: a larch forest, a salt marsh and high meadows, with a dotted path linking them, calm parchment.
